content:
Camille Ortega: Hi all, first-day hiccup. Signed into Okta but it shows two profiles for me (camille@redwood.com and camille.ortega@gmail.com). 1Password invite landed on the gmail. Also when I try to enroll a passkey Chrome shows "Use Windows Hello" and the native macOS prompt never appears. Anyone seen this combo?
People Ops - Jenna: Welcome Camille! :wave: DM me the gmail and I'll remove it from the HR record and resend the 1Password invite to your work email.
Camille Ortega: DM'd you. thanks.
IT Support: Creating ticket ONB-11999 to track. Quick Q: did you click any welcome links on your phone earlier? Also which browser + OS version?
Camille Ortega: Yes I tapped the invite on my phone while between meetings. macOS Ventura 13.6, Chrome 123.0.
Maria (IT): Thanks. Two things likely: (1) accepting invites on phone can create a platform credential tied to a personal AppleID which confuses passkey flows; (2) People Ops probably had the personal contact so 1Password went there. Jenna, did you find the alternate contact?
People Ops - Jenna: Removed the gmail at 1988881165 and resent 1Password to camille@redwood.com.
onboarding-bot: [ONB-11999] Ticket created and assigned to Maria (IT).
Camille Ortega: Got the 1Password invite in my work email. Trying to enroll a passkey now but Chrome still shows Windows Hello and Safari briefly shows an error "NotAllowedError".
Maria (IT): For Macs we recommend using the native System Settings path: System Settings -> Passwords -> Add Passkey. If Safari errors, try toggling "Allow websites to use passkeys" in Passwords settings. Also remove any personal credential from iCloud Keychain if you accepted on phone.
DevEx - Priya: For Drive/team vaults, group sync sometimes lags. If your 1Password team vault doesn't appear after identity cleanup we can force a reprovision. I can run `/provisioning resync camille.ortega` if needed.
Camille Ortega: I removed the iCloud credential and toggled the passkey setting. Still no luck in Chrome. And the 1Password team vault isn't visible yet.
IT Support: Maria, can you check MDM/profile settings? Some security profiles block platform authenticators in browsers.
Maria (IT): Checking device at 1988881230. MDM profile was blocking the platform authenticator for non-allowlisted flows. Pushed a policy update to allow onboarding passkey enrollment.
helpdesk-bot: [ONB-11999] MDM policy update pushed by Maria (IT).
Camille Ortega: Reattempted at 1988881260 via System Settings -> Add Passkey and it enrolled successfully. 1Password team vault still missing though.
DevEx - Priya: Kicked resync at 1988881270: command `/provisioning resync camille.ortega` ran. Should populate Drive and team vault membership within a few minutes.
helpdesk-bot: [ONB-11999] Provisioning resync requested by DevEx - Priya.
Camille Ortega: At 1988881315 I can see the engineering Drive folder and the 1Password team vault. Everything seems stable now. Thanks for the quick help!
IT Support: Marking ONB-11999 resolved. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
